CustomField.description: This is a formula field that will calculate the opportunity's current value based on stage but not on probability for pipeline reports.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Identified"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Acceptance"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Credit Submittal"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Statements In - MCA"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Credit Review"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Pre-Qual MCA"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Deferred")), Amount, IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Approved - Lease"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Approved - MCA"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Offer Out - Lease"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Offer In - Lease"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Offer Out - MCA"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Offer In - MCA")), Approval_Amount__c , IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Docs Out"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Docs In"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Docs Out - MCA"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Docs In - MCA"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Up for Funding"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Submission - MCA/ALT"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Conversion")),Amount_Offered__c , IF( AND( OR($RecordType.Name = "Working Capital Oppty",$RecordType.Name = "Broker WC Oppty",$RecordType.Name = "Broker FRPSA",$RecordType.Name = "FRPSA"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Funded")), ACTUAL_AMT_OFFERED__c , IF( AND( $RecordType.Name = "Lease Oppty" , ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Funded")), Actual_Equip_Cost__c , 0) ) ) ))
